 The lineup for the 2027 edition of the Boardwalk Rock festival has been unveiled, featuring headliners Iron Maiden , Korn , and Bad Omens , along with Alice in Chains, Judas Priest, Marilyn Manson, Breaking Benjamin, GWAR, and dozens more acts.
 Following a hiatus in 2026, the three-day fest is set to return May 14th-16th in Ocean City, Maryland. A pre-sale will begin on Thursday, October 22nd, at 10 a.m ET at this location , with a passcode available for those who sign up here .
 Buy Boardwalk Rock 2027 Tickets Here 
 Advertisement 
 On Friday, May 14th, Korn will headline a bill that includes Breaking Benjamin, The Prodigy, Cypress Hill, Slash Featuring Myles Kennedy and the Conspirators, Clutch, Sevendust, and more.
 Saturday, May 15th, will see Bad Omens topping a lineup that features Good Charlotte, Marilyn Manson, Motionless in White, Poppy, Tesla, and others.
 And on Sunday, May 16th, Iron Maiden will close out the fest with a headlining set, following performances by Alice in Chains, Judas Priest, The Pretty Reckless, Down, The Warning, Loathe, The Hu, GWAR, Mac Sabbath, and more.
